meta.name: info-funnel
meta.description: 3-6 阶递减漏斗, 突出转化率 / 筛选比例 / 流量损耗。竖图适合 IG Story / 小红书

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作转化漏斗图，突出流量损耗与筛选比例
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在社交媒体上展示营销漏斗数据
copy.tagline_en: Create conversion funnel charts highlighting traffic loss and filter ratios
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to present marketing funnel data on social media

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成一张竖屏漏斗图，展示从大到小的转化或筛选过程。每阶段显示数字和转化率，底部总结累计结果和最大流失环节。
howto.when: 当你要求制作漏斗图，并给出 3 到 6 个阶段及其数值时触发。

say.text: 画一个招聘漏斗：投递5000，面试800，录用120，入职90。
say.note: Claude 会生成 4 阶漏斗图，突出筛选比例。

howto.what_en: Claude generates a vertical funnel infographic showing a decreasing process from top to bottom. Each stage displays absolute numbers and conversion rates, with a summary at the bottom of cumulative results and the biggest drop-off.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a funnel chart and provide 3 to 6 stages with their values.

say_en.text: Create a SaaS signup funnel: 100k visitors, 18.5k signups, 6.2k trials, 1.45k paid, 920 retained.
say_en.note: Claude generates a 5-stage funnel with conversion rates and insights.

say_en.text: Make a recruitment funnel: 5000 applicants, 800 interviews, 120 offers, 90 hires.
say_en.note: Claude generates a 4-stage funnel highlighting screening ratios.
